body: Forward test of the management-tone-vs-delivery method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Three price hikes in CY26; CEO Vidhya Srinivasan: 'we don't give forward-looking guidances… there is volatility'; MD Govindarajan: 'the range bound on the percentage is not what is driving us… absolute profit'; analyst notes 'other expenditure surge'. Two consecutive quarters at/below 24% and new capacity costs lean below the naive 'stays near recent levels' base.
